QuestInfo.name: Neinheart the Tactician
QuestInfo.0: Now you have to meet up with #p1101000#'s Tactician, #b#p1101002##k, and discuss what you have to do in the future.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# claimed that you may be too weak to fight for Maple World, and therefore refused to name you as a Knight-in-Training. He stated that the training period towards becoming a Knight-in-Training is already set up, and that you need to meet up with #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.
